covered_report_window.plain_language: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the Wednesday, September 2, 2026 U.S. market close and before the Thursday, September 3, 2026 U.S. market open

methodology.consensus_direction: arithmetic mean of Pass A, Pass B, and Pass C direction scores
methodology.consensus_reversal_risk: arithmetic mean of Pass A, Pass B, and Pass C reversal-risk values
methodology.disparity: average of half the direction-score range and the reversal-risk range, rounded to a 0-100 scale

market_context_summary: U.S. equities were modestly higher intraday as oil prices and bond yields stabilized after two weak sessions, while Middle East conflict, inflation sensitivity, Thursday jobless claims and Friday payrolls kept macro risk elevated.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Backlog growth and FY26 revenue raise
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record backlog and upward revisions support a beat-and-raise, though valuation makes execution essential.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $1.63-$1.64B revenue and $1.72-$1.73 adjusted EPS; bullish previews sit above consensus.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Backlog expands beyond $7.7B and full-year revenue guidance rises.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Pump-laser or modem constraints cap shipments or margins.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Stock has run sharply and carries a roughly 120x trailing P/E, increasing sell-the-news risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Bottom-line estimates moved modestly higher over the prior 60 days.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: AI semiconductor revenue and Q4 AI guide
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: AI networking and accelerator demand favor upside, but the stock needs more than an in-line $16B AI quarter.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About $29.3-$29.4B revenue and $3.21-$3.24 EPS, with options implying roughly 8.2%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: AI revenue clears $16B and next-quarter commentary confirms acceleration.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Advanced-node constraints or a merely in-line AI outlook trigger another sell-the-news reaction.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Calls lead puts, but downside-protection skew and a large implied move show a demanding setup.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Wall Street remains strongly bullish, while some previews warn the October quarter could sit below estimates.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Cloud & AI revenue with server margins
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record Q2 momentum and raised FY26 guidance support another positive print if server margins hold.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is near $11.87-$11.91B revenue and $0.93 EPS, at the top of company guidance.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Cloud & AI demand remains strong and Juniper synergies support margins.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: DRAM/NAND inflation lifts revenue but not units or profitability.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 14%, below the prior event but still a high hurdle.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Institutional previews are positive after the prior quarter's large beat and FY26 raise.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Severe revenue contraction and weak sales execution favor downside, but expectations and valuation are already compressed.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About $52.1M revenue, down roughly 26%-45% depending on comparison, and a $0.25 adjusted loss.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Bookings, federal demand, or guidance show the sales reset working sooner than expected.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Revenue stays near the low guide and gross margin or pipeline quality deteriorates.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply 13.5%; recent call volume exceeded puts by nearly 50-to-1, creating squeeze and unwind risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Consensus is Moderate Sell and FY27 revenue is still expected to contract.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Comparable sales and FY26 margin guide
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A 266% one-year rally leaves little room for a merely good turnaround quarter despite improving sales.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Comparable sales and pricing power accelerate while tariff mitigation protects margins.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Guidance fails to justify the rally or tariff costs erode profit.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: The pre-earnings run is the central crowding risk; the stock previously fell despite a beat.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Prior-quarter EPS nearly doubled consensus, keeping the whisper bar elevated.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Persistent Snacks contraction and weak FY27 expectations create a modest downside edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is about $0.39; focus is on FY27 organic sales, especially Snacks.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Rao's and Meals & Beverages offset Snacks and management offers credible stabilization.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Snacks organic sales remain around a 4% decline and guidance disappoints.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Compressed valuation and defensive demand limit reversal severity.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Stephens cut its target and models Snacks organic sales down 4.1% in FY26 and 4.3% in FY27.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Usage and AI adoption support growth, but the stock appears priced for another material beat-and-raise.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: About $1.48B total revenue and $0.45 EPS; options imply roughly 10.5%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Product revenue and RPO accelerate with maintained 75% product margin.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Guidance only meets consensus or consumption growth moderates.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: A steep four-month rally and high implied move make sell-the-news risk substantial.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Analyst tone is constructive after the prior quarter's 37% stock reaction.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: All-flash momentum, strong cash generation, and upward estimate signals create a modest upside edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Company guided $1.75-$1.90B revenue and $2.05-$2.15 non-GAAP EPS.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: All-flash growth remains high teens and FY27 revenue guidance rises.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: AI storage demand or public-cloud growth slows and the move stays inside implied volatility.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Monthly options imply about 11.9%, a demanding magnitude benchmark.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The most accurate estimate sits above consensus, signaling recent positive revisions.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A high price and uneven recent reaction history leave a mild downside bias unless comps clearly exceed expectations.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $1.22B revenue and $1.40 EPS.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Traffic and Five Beyond conversions support another comp-sales raise.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Consumer pressure or cautious guidance repeats the prior 13.8% post-earnings decline.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Recent event moves have ranged from -13.8% to +10.7%, supporting elevated reversal risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Evidence is mixed; timing and consensus are confirmed, but current revision breadth is limited.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: ARR growth and path to profitability
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Strong category growth is offset by losses, a short public history, and extreme event volatility.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $214M revenue and a $0.07 adjusted loss.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: ARR holds near 30% growth and free-cash-flow guidance improves.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: NewEdge investment delays operating leverage or guidance disappoints.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options indicate roughly 20%-23% movement; the prior report produced a roughly 19% next-day decline.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Analysts remain bullish on sales, but public estimate history is shallow.

disclaimer_text: This is research, not financial advice. Earnings reactions are highly uncertain and can be driven by market positioning, guidance, macro conditions, and management commentary rather than reported results alone.
